'''Pokeleaf''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in the [[Two Rivers]] region. A preparation of pokeleaf is a remedy for toothaches and sore gums.{{ref/book|5|49}}

Pokeleaf can also be used to wash artificial color out of a person's hair. It is less effective ridding hair of a red dye than a black dye.{{ref/book|5|49}}
